research_question: Does LPWM representation adaptation improve planning over the same planner trained on a fixed Stage1 world model?
precision: FP32 fixed image encoder, BF16 dynamics/planner, no-grad world model in eval mode
schedule: linear warmup 1 percent updates, cosine decay to 10 percent initial LR
planner_input: four observed RGB frames, current 8D ego status, causal eight-step LPWM prior rollout
encoder_conditioning: Encoder-command FiLM is frozen at its Stage1-compatible zero-output initialization. Ego command still enters the unchanged planner ego projection.
planning_loss: Soft candidate imitation + six official PDM subscore BCE + 0.02 original SSL, no direct object GT auxiliary loss.
world_loss: Same0.02 official SSL scalar and independently sampled world8 clips retained as a no-grad monitor; no LPWM or planner update from this constant.
data: all eligible observed-input navtrain training records, same recording validation split as stage1; no fixed clip cap
checkpoint_selection: fixed final epoch, epoch diagnostics do not select the best development checkpoint
evaluation: Same preregistered 1024 planning / 256 world development scenes as the ongoing partial baseline; paired method comparison, no independent-test claim.

DrivoR.use: compact perception memory and trajectory-conditioned subscore decoder; our fixed vocabulary replaces continuous proposal generation

DriveSuprim.use: reviewed candidate imitation and metric distillation; coarse-to-fine selection and camera augmentation deferred

Hydra-MDP.use: train-only trajectory vocabulary and privileged simulator metric distillation; official implementation unavailable at review

Drive-JEPA.use: reviewed safe multimodal trajectory supervision; full PF checkpoint remains an unchanged evaluation reference

SafeDrive_workspace.use: read-only reference: candidate refinement, scene safety and temporal drivable supervision, live rescoring of refined trajectories; no BEV-coordinate or object-identity assumptions transferred

object_auxiliary.association: detached multi-particle Gaussian ROI overlap, no presence weighting or one-to-one constraint; GT boxes enter loss only

comparison: Fixed-representation planner baseline for Adapter/LoRA: same Stage1, planner initialization, seed47,1epoch, data order, losses and panels. Also freezes encoder FiLM and uses eval mode for LPWM; full adaptation retains different conv_in conditioning and20epoch scheduler.
object_supervision_decision: Deferred by user; not scheduled in this method comparison.

resource_limits.interpretation: 48decimalGB total per card including other users; dynamic allocator budget from current NVML usage; batch8 preferred whenever safe; no fixed23.2GiB allowance or independent3GiB reserve

partial_finetuning.rgb_decoder: Frozen together with all LPWM weights and buffers; no-grad SSL monitor only.
partial_finetuning.initialization: Independent run from the same Stage1 SSL checkpoint and seed47 planner; no warm start from other Stage2 methods.

trend_evaluation.selection: recording round-robin with stable token hash, fixed before any predictions

frozen_control.planner_initialization: Same seed47 and original candidate-planner initialization as Adapter/LoRA, never a trained Stage2 planner.
frozen_control.scope: Strict fixed representation: world parameters/buffers and encoder command FiLM frozen. The planner still receives ego intent.
frozen_control.interpretation: Compares adaptation including encoder FiLM and train-mode regularization with a fixed representation; does not isolate individual adapter weights.
